description: Bundle-size budget for scripts/check-bundle-size.js (roadmap W10.1). `targets` are the budgets the gate was written with; the bundle has never met them. `ceilings` are the measured sizes on 2026-10-01 (vendor-map 2598 KB, index 726 KB, total 10758 KB) plus ~2% headroom, so the gate can block in CI today: growth past a ceiling fails, and a ceiling more than 5% above what is measured fails too, until it is lowered. Ceilings only go DOWN — DEFECT-0027 (the schema chunk in the client bundle) is the first planned reduction. W10.1b (2026-10-01) lowered both: removing the MapLibre preview engine (maplibre-gl held the repo's one critical advisory) took vendor-map from 2598 to 1796 KB and the total from 10758 to 9958 KB. A chunk named here is keyed by its Vite name, without the content hash. W2 (2026-10-10) lowered both again: Mapbox GL replaced by MapLibre GL 6 (with maplibre-contour and pmtiles in the same chunk) took vendor-map from 1796 to 1068 KB and the total to 9435 KB; ceilings are those plus ~2%. CORRECTION 2026-10-11 (launch stack -> main): the W2 total of 9435 KB was measured before the W2 audit's fix that emits the MapLibre web worker as its own asset (maplibre-gl-worker, 495 KB; without it every map was blank in production), so the 9625 KB total ceiling was never true of a working build. Measured with the worker on the integrated stack: 10008 KB, against main's 9958 KB on the same day (+50 KB, 0.5%: vendor-map -729 KB, worker +495 KB, W3-W5 pages +~280 KB). The total ceiling returns to main's 10160 KB -- no increase over main, 1.5% above measured, inside the 5% lowering slack. vendor-map stays at 1090 KB. The bundle-size check runs only on PRs into main (ci.yml), so it never ran on the stacked W2-W5 branches; that is how the stale number survived. 2026-10-12 (route-load performance): the mobile quick-add sheet (zod, shared contracts, cmdk) moved out of the entry chunk to load on first tap; index measured 733 -> 616 KB, ceiling that plus ~2% (628 KB). The total rose 10008 -> 10047 KB (the sheet's code now ships as separate lazy chunks instead of inside the entry; nothing was added), still under the 10160 KB ceiling. Re-measured 2026-10-18 after merging main (0d0890fd, then af599527): index 616 KB (630450 bytes; ceiling 628 KB unchanged, measured +2%, below main's 745 KB), total 10074 KB. 2026-10-20 (entry chunk back under budget): the 2026-10-19 commits (Fieldstone redesign, branding editor + accessibility prefs sync, pricing static catalog) took index to 643198 bytes, 126 bytes over its 628 KB ceiling, failing CI on main. The mobile More drawer (MobileCommandDrawer, with vaul) and the early-access feedback dialog moved out of the entry chunk to load on first open (same pattern as the quick-add sheet); index measured 643198 -> 602396 bytes (588 KB), inside the 600 KB target, so its ceiling is removed (the gate demands it) and index is now held to the 600 KB target like every other chunk — a tighter limit, not a looser one. The total rose 10093 -> 10112 KB (the moved code and the small shared UI modules it split out now ship as separate lazy chunks; nothing was added), still under the 10160 KB ceiling. 2026-10-29 (V-Tax-1 T1 had taken main to 10164 KB, 4 KB over the total ceiling, failing CI on main): jsPDF's two lazy optional dependencies -- html2canvas (doc.html()) and canvg with its core-js (doc.addSvgAsImage()) -- resolve to a throwing stub in vite.config.ts, because AcreOS's one PDF (the borrower statement) is text and lines only and they could never load (tests/unit/jspdfOptionalDepsStubbed.test.ts pins that no jsPDF consumer calls either, and that dompurify, which isomorphic-dompurify needs, is not stubbed). Measured 10164 -> 9812 KB on main at b8c6ea9d. On main after V-Tax-1 T2a (#420, 7feb5a31), which CI measured at 10174 KB, the total is 9822 KB (10057775 bytes). The total ceiling is set tight to that, rounded up to the next KB (9823 KB), per the founder's 2026-10-29 bundle-trim task.
